title: Han Hwe

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.
December 14th 1918

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
With reference to the report of the 13th inst on the receipt by General Yang of two bombs which with an abusive letter were left at his yamen by two men posing as officers sent by the Vice President to inspect the Camp at Loongwha, General Yang has received a telegram from Nanking in reply to his enquiry informing him that no such persons were sent on the mission stated and advising strong police efforts to effect the arrest of the imposters. The telegram also conveyed the information that many of the repatriated Honan rebels were drifting back to Shanghai.
Han Hwe 韩惠 is again trying to attain prominence in labour circles. He has communicated with various workmans Guilds in the City informing them that he proposes shortly to visit and examine the working of the various branches of labour societies.
A fete in aid of the fund for German and Austrian prisoners of war will open at Chang Su Ho's garden on the 15th inst and continue on the 16th instant.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
上海工部局。
1918年12月14日

警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

关于本月13日呈报的杨将军收到两枚炸弹一事，该两枚炸弹系由两名冒充副总统派往龙华军营视察的军官的男子留置于其衙门内，并附有一封辱骂信。杨将军已收到南京复电，答复其查询，告知并未派遣此类人员执行所述任务，并建议警方大力缉捕 imposters（冒名顶替者）。该电报还传达消息称，许多被遣返的河南叛乱分子正流回上海。

韩惠 (Han Hwe) 再次试图在劳工界崭露头角。他已与市内各工人公会联络，告知他们他拟于近期走访并考察各劳工社团分支的运作情况。

一项为德奥战俘基金筹款的游艺会将于本月15日在张叔和花园开幕，并持续至本月16日。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。
